Method of Attack: Ransomware operation attacking enterprise targets by gaining access to admin credentials and spreading throughout a Windows network
Deploying ransomware payloads to all devices on the network once access to a Windows domain controller is gained
Double-extortion strategy by stealing unencrypted data and threatening to release it on data leak sites if ransom is not paid
Indicators of Compromise: DoppelPaymer Tor payment site demanding 1,100 Bitcoins (~$16.7 million)
